title: College Football
description:
Portland State at Oregon
The Portland State Vikings (0-3) face the No. 21 Oregon Ducks (1-1) at Autzen Stadium. The Ducks suffered a 39-31 road upset against the Cowboys last week, while the Vikings were handed a 47-23 home defeat against the Fighting Hawks.

title: College Football
description:
Buffalo at Penn State
The No. 14 Penn State Nittany Lions host the Buffalo Bulls at Beaver Stadium. Penn State enters Week 3 with a 2-0 record after beating Temple, 27-9, in Week 2, while Buffalo dropped its Week 2 matchup against Florida International, 33-20.

title: College Football
description:
Texas-El Paso at Michigan
The No. 19 Michigan Wolverines (2-0) host the UTEP Miners (1-1) at Michigan Stadium. Michigan beat Oklahoma, 17-10, in Week 2. The Miners rebounded following a shutout loss to the Sooners in Week 1 to beat the Tigers, 51-10, in Week 2.

title: College Football
description:
North Dakota at Nebraska
The Nebraska Cornhuskers (2-0) host the North Dakota Fighting Hawks (3-0) at Memorial Stadium. North Dakota enters Week 3 on a three-game win streak after beating Portland State 47-23, while Nebraska is 2-0 following a 56-7 win over Bowling Green.

title: College Football
description:
Purdue at UCLA
The UCLA Bruins host the Purdue Boilermakers at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena. UCLA enters following a 28-10 victory over the San Diego State Aztecs, while Purdue arrives after suffering a 38-36 double-overtime loss against the Wake Forest Demon Deacons.
